title: Tiny, cute planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetBody' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#f7b94a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d9772e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- back half of ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#8fd7e8' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='70 42' stroke-dashoffset='104' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>
  <!-- planet -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='24' fill='url(#planetBody)'/>
  <!-- soft polar cap -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#fff3cf' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- band stripes -->
  <path d='M27 45 Q50 53 73 45' fill='none' stroke='#c4611f' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.55'/>
  <path d='M29 56 Q50 63 71 56' fill='none' stroke='#f8d98a' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3b2a5c'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='46' r='2.6' fill='#3b2a5c'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M45 52 Q50 57 55 52' fill='none' stroke='#3b2a5c' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9d7a' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#ff9d7a' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- front half of ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#b8eef8' stroke-width='6' stroke-dasharray='70 42' stroke-dashoffset='42' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>
  <!-- ring tips glow -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='60' r='3' fill='#d8f7ff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='44' r='3' fill='#d8f7ff'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='74' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
